Added 4 console commands in ChooseTheAncientConsoleCommands.cs while adjusting logic in Coordinator, FlowState, and SelectionScreen. These are ctaact, ctastay, ctaskip, ctaffsay.
Coordinator and flow were heavily touched to implement the cmds functions, with selection screen preforming some removing of extra screens and showing and hiding the supressed ancient dialouge and preview. An ChooseTheAncientFlowCompletion enum was made in Coordinator consisting of Completed, Cancled, Falied to handle the console command outputs or states the selection screen ends up. Completed means the ballot result was applied and the command may enter the Ancient room. Canceled means another console command superseded it, so temporary state should be restored without treating it as an error. Failed means the flow could not complete, such as an invalid act model or a caught console-ballot failure.
The new ChooseTheAncientConsoleCommands.cs contains all the console commands. This adds an enum ConsoleSelectionResolutionMode that has SkipAndContinue and CancelFlow. SkipAndContinue is for ctaskip when the ballot is canceled and progression continues. CancelFlow is used when a new ctaact or ctastay replaces an older active command.
ConsoleCommands.cs also handles net issues to handle error cases where multiple players use commands one after another. This is because any players command will affect all players equally with the exception of ctaffsay that is just changing what is visible on the local screen. This is why a custom message is added.
Harmony Patches are made to Runmanager InitializeShared and DevConsole ProcessCommand.

The custom message is necessary. ctaact and ctastay return a task that remains incomplete while the selection ballot is open. Therefore the networked console action remains active until the ballot resolves. When multiple are done, they'd normally be in a queue for all peers but won't resolve as the selection stops it from finishing. The custom message allows them to cancel and finish.

Overhauled the transition flow for act 2, 3 and onwards so that instead of using EnterNextActPatch.cs we instead use a new route to show the selection screen. This allows the next act map to load behind and be visible to the player if they press it. After selecting an ancient, the ancient should immediately show just like how it works in the console commands. It should also allow us to simplify the current ctaact commands to act commands.
patches were added: -EnterActStartingAncientPatch.s -NMapScreenStartingAncientPatch.cs - SelectonScreenMainMenuCleanupPatch.cs -UnresolvedAcctStartMapIconPatch.cs
The EnterNextActPatch was removed. Act1StartMapIconPatch was removed. SetCurrentRoomPatch was removed.
Work on meassuring the performance of transitions was done to work out the lag spike in round transitions. The following performance improvements were made: -tween transition is smooth. The full list is here: -retained finalist Ancient viewports; -pre-layout before preview creation; -autosize-once preview setup; -skipping redundant layout/theme writes; -inline-image prewarming; -reduced config polling. The big things are the ancient finalists not being remade, the reduced config polling, and the prewarm asset caching.
